notes.title: Anonymous Hacker Simulator is releasing on 3rd April 2024
notes.content:
Hello players,

Anonymous Hacker Simulator will be launched on [b]3rd April 2024[/b]. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist and participate in the playtest, which will kick off a few days before the official release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/d97ce5526be862dd84a0a2c2b82a0a2b68668f55.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487060/Anonymous_Hacker_Simulator/

The full game will provide a whopping 50 gigs of content, featuring a diverse range of experiences. From intriguing storylines involving mystery and detective work to scandals involving celebrities and public outrage, as well as entertaining pranks, there's something for everyone. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to acquire various apartments, ranging from cozy medium-sized apartment to luxury villa.

We've introduced several quality-of-life (QoL) enhancements, including:

[h3]Enhanced Window Management
[/h3]
When clicking on some apps, it will now open any existing window before creating a new one, reducing clutter on the screen.

[h3]Improved Terminal Functionality:
[/h3]
Commands that don't require any flags no longer need the "--" prefix. For example:

Before: Nmap -- IP
Now: Nmap IP

[h3]Music Player:
[/h3]

Enjoy the ability to select and shuffle your music, as well as discover new tracks through the marketplace app.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/47aab62bd60e4b72f6174dc10ef57e5333359b2c.png[/img]

[h3]Wallpapers:
[/h3]

Easily change your wallpapers and discover new ones through the marketplace app.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/d09e02d9094b80ac9c07591b0548ecf1e6b556ff.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you all for playing the prologue version and sharing your feedback. Originally, we planned to release the game in Q4. Unfortunately, the region where our developers work is facing increased war conflict, making working conditions difficult. As a result, we have to delay the game until Early 2024 as shipping this month is nearly impossible.

We are working on improving working conditions and trying to speed up game development.

Currently, we are focused on the playtest version, an improved version of the prologue/demo with added new features.

[h3]Improved Help:[/h3] 
The game now includes a helpful menu for more guidance. For example, if you want to perform a DDoS attack but forgot how, the help menu can provide more information.

[h3]Added Difficulty Levels:[/h3]
Some players found the game too guided. We added an "experienced" difficulty level that offers minimal guidance, letting you figure out things on your own.
Here you can see a step-by-step gig example for each difficulty level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/11ddec25ba510aa0cddea4114031ba25d25a8cfb.jpg[/img]

[h3]More Outdoor Activity:[/h3]
The game will have more outdoor activities for both main and side gigs. Side gigs might involve playful pranks, like going to a nearby hotel, locking doors, and playing loud music at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/d3e0b2b40c8c0cc49a099491203a34337b01b22c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/bbb6a92585c10c4891250c573845c3b842d0db01.jpg[/img]

[h3]Expanded Gameplay Loop:[/h3]
Instead of just receiving an IP address and hacking, we added a new feature. Now, you can scan nearby WiFi networks, discover connected devices, and try to hack them. For example, at the DJ party, you'll need to use "netdiscover" to find nearby devices and hack into the main DJ computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/5011ed275020a4a6ac0b776e4185bc86e987da4e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Expanded Search:[/h3]
As you progress, you'll unlock new searching abilities. Encountered individuals without information before? Now you will be able to discover their secrets, unlocking more hidden gigs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/90b3e4636ce98290f38b1f0b92db4102f0ab7165.jpg[/img]

[h3]Heat level:[/h3]

As you play, your heat level will increase, making you a target for other hackers. For example, a hacker might place a bounty on you, someone could add your name to a wanted list, and you might need to clear your name. Another hacker might engage in a cyberwar with you, like someone from the DJ party you hacked earlier. These will be detailed gigs rather than just "solve a puzzle to escape".

We'll keep you updated as we work through challenges and aim to provide an improved gaming experience. Your understanding and support are appreciated.

Best regards,

notes.title: Play the Anonymous Hacker Simulator demo now!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487060/Anonymous_Hacker_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/48cd00a117e2eceb3960670a727b6d07d13db47b.png[/img][/url]

[b][h2]Hey, Virtual Revolutionaries![/h2]

[h2]We've got news that will set your hearts racing - our long-awaited game, "Anonymous Hacker Simulator," is now available as a demo at the Demo Festival![/h2][/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487060/Anonymous_Hacker_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/e9e8c3cd1ddb00151b6a24bf5b6b689d0267d749.png[/img][/url]

[h3]This demo build is like a return to our roots - almost the same as the initial prologue. But we didn't take you there by accident. We've combed through every line of code and fixed all the glitches so that you can fully experience our dark and intriguing world of hacking.[/h3]

[h3]Don't spend too much time pondering - grab your keyboard and mouse, then venture into cyberspace to feel what it's like to be an anonymous warrior in the digital realm.[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487060/Anonymous_Hacker_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312357/39e4fe28b234a93e5ce72ae7744ae28008066451.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Our heartfelt thanks go out to our dedicated fans who've stood by us all this time. It's for you and your support that we've created this demo. Now it's time for your feedback - [i]play, test, and let us know what you think![/i]

[b]As for the full game release, we won't keep you in suspense for too long. Soon, we'll unveil the release date, so get ready for an exciting journey into the dark corners of virtual reality.[/b]

Thank you for your unwavering support, and we can't wait to hear your reactions to the "Anonymous Hacker Simulator" demo! Remember, this is just the beginning...[/h3]
